---
title: "Final manuscript revision outputs"
output: md_document
params:
  bootstrap_iterations: 5000
  bootstrap_seed: 2027
---

This analysis uses only saved model outputs. It regenerates the scale-free Kather
summary and the external confusion-matrix supplement without training or inference.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

if (!exists("params")) {
  params <- list(bootstrap_iterations = 5000, bootstrap_seed = 2027)
}

locate_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (dir.exists(file.path(current, "artifacts")) &&
        dir.exists(file.path(current, "analysis"))) return(current)
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) stop("Could not locate project root")
    current <- parent
  }
}

project_root <- locate_project_root()
paper_root <- file.path(project_root, "analysis")
output_root <- file.path(paper_root, "manuscript_revision_outputs")
figure_root <- file.path(paper_root, "manuscript_figures")
dir.create(output_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

model_order <- c("ResNet18", "DINOv2", "UNI")
model_colors <- c(ResNet18 = "#3568A8", DINOv2 = "#D17818", UNI = "#21896E")
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  ))
```

```{r helpers}
hierarchical_mean_ci <- function(frame, value_column, iterations, seed) {
  image_values <- frame |>
    group_by(case_id, cohort_id) |>
    summarise(value = mean(.data[[value_column]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(is.finite(value))
  sources <- unique(image_values$case_id)
  set.seed(seed)
  estimates <- replicate(iterations, {
    sampled_sources <- sample(sources, length(sources), replace = TRUE)
    sampled_values <- unlist(lapply(sampled_sources, function(source) {
      source_values <- image_values$value[image_values$case_id == source]
      sample(source_values, length(source_values), replace = TRUE)
    }))
    mean(sampled_values)
  })
  tibble(
    mean = mean(image_values$value),
    ci_low = unname(quantile(estimates, 0.025)),
    ci_high = unname(quantile(estimates, 0.975)),
    images = n_distinct(image_values$cohort_id),
    source_groups = n_distinct(image_values$case_id)
  )
}
```

## Scale-free Kather primary analysis

```{r kather-primary}
kather_root <- file.path(project_root, "artifacts", "kather5k_jpi_revision")
image_seed <- read_csv(
  file.path(kather_root, "evaluation/consolidated/image_seed_metrics.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
paired_tests <- read_csv(
  file.path(kather_root, "statistics/paired_model_tests.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
top_random <- read_csv(
  file.path(kather_root, "statistics/paired_top_vs_random.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

primary <- image_seed |>
  filter(
    cohort_name == "selected_faithfulness",
    analysis_family == "primary_jointly_correct_true_class",
    target_role == "true_class",
    perturbation == "normalized_zero",
    grid_label == "common_14",
    (model == "ResNet18" & method == "gradcam") |
      (model %in% c("DINOv2", "UNI") & method == "gradient_attention_rollout")
  )

stopifnot(n_distinct(primary$seed) == 3, n_distinct(primary$case_id) == 10)

metric_map <- c(
  attribution_occlusion_spearman = "Attribution-occlusion Spearman",
  top_minus_random_relative_target_logit_reduction_auc =
    "Relative target-logit top-minus-random AUC"
)

metric_ci <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(metric_map), function(metric_index) {
  metric <- names(metric_map)[metric_index]
  bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(model_order), function(model_index) {
    model <- model_order[model_index]
    hierarchical_mean_ci(
      filter(primary, .data$model == .env$model), metric,
      params$bootstrap_iterations,
      params$bootstrap_seed + 100L * metric_index + model_index
    ) |>
      mutate(model = .env$model, metric = unname(metric_map[[metric]]))
  }))
}))

top_beats <- top_random |>
  filter(
    cohort_name == "selected_faithfulness",
    analysis_family == "primary_jointly_correct_true_class",
    perturbation == "normalized_zero",
    grid_label == "common_14",
    metric == "top_minus_random_relative_target_logit_reduction_auc",
    model %in% model_order
  ) |>
  transmute(
    model,
    metric = "Fraction: top deletion beats random",
    mean = proportion_top_beats_random,
    ci_low = NA_real_, ci_high = NA_real_,
    images, source_groups
  )

primary_table <- metric_ci |>
  select(model, metric, mean) |>
  bind_rows(select(top_beats, model, metric, mean)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = mean) |>
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = model_order)) |>
  arrange(model)

write_csv(primary_table, file.path(output_root, "table_kather_scale_free_primary.csv"))

scale_free_pairwise <- paired_tests |>
  filter(
    cohort_name == "selected_faithfulness",
    analysis_family == "primary_jointly_correct_true_class",
    method_family == "architecture_primary",
    perturbation == "normalized_zero",
    grid_label == "common_14",
    metric %in% names(metric_map),
    model_a == "UNI"
  ) |>
  select(
    metric, model_a, model_b, image_count, source_group_count,
    mean_difference, hierarchical_ci_low, hierarchical_ci_high,
    wilcoxon_p_holm, source_sign_flip_p_holm
  )
write_csv(scale_free_pairwise, file.path(output_root, "table_kather_scale_free_pairwise.csv"))

plot_data <- bind_rows(metric_ci, top_beats) |>
  mutate(
    model = factor(model, levels = model_order),
    metric = factor(metric, levels = c(
      "Attribution-occlusion Spearman",
      "Relative target-logit top-minus-random AUC",
      "Fraction: top deletion beats random"
    ))
  )

primary_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(model, mean, color = model)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.35, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high), width = 0.14, linewidth = 0.65,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = model_colors) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = NULL,
    title = "Primary Kather-5K faithfulness uses scale-free cross-model evidence",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Image-level means across seeds 11, 89, and 181; intervals are ",
      "source-group hierarchical 95% CIs (", params$bootstrap_iterations, " resamples)"
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 18, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9)
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(figure_root, "figure_05_kather_scale_free_faithfulness.pdf"),
  primary_plot, width = 10.4, height = 3.7
)
ggsave(
  file.path(figure_root, "figure_05_kather_scale_free_faithfulness.png"),
  primary_plot, width = 10.4, height = 3.7, dpi = 320
)
```

## Secondary raw-score deletion trajectories

```{r raw-deletion-secondary}
legacy_curves <- read_csv(
  file.path(
    project_root, "artifacts", "dinov2_three_model", "faithfulness",
    "three_model_deletion_curves.csv"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  filter(target_role == "predicted", fraction_removed <= 0.30)

curve_metrics <- c(
  target_class_logit_drop = "Target-class logit decrease",
  target_margin_drop = "Classification-margin decrease"
)

curve_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(curve_metrics), function(metric_index) {
  metric <- names(curve_metrics)[metric_index]
  groups <- legacy_curves |>
    distinct(model, strategy, fraction_removed) |>
    arrange(model, strategy, fraction_removed)
  bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(groups)), function(group_index) {
    key <- groups[group_index, ]
    frame <- legacy_curves |>
      filter(
        model == key$model,
        strategy == key$strategy,
        fraction_removed == key$fraction_removed
      )
    hierarchical_mean_ci(
      frame, metric, params$bootstrap_iterations,
      params$bootstrap_seed + 1000L * metric_index + group_index
    ) |>
      mutate(
        model = key$model,
        strategy = key$strategy,
        fraction_removed = key$fraction_removed,
        metric = unname(curve_metrics[[metric]])
      )
  }))
}))

curve_plot <- curve_summary |>
  mutate(
    model = factor(model, levels = model_order),
    strategy = factor(strategy, levels = c("top", "random", "bottom")),
    metric = factor(metric, levels = unname(curve_metrics))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(fraction_removed, mean, color = strategy, fill = strategy)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high), alpha = 0.13, linewidth = 0) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(metric ~ model, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), breaks = c(0, .1, .2, .3)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(top = "#B33A3A", random = "#555555", bottom = "#3B75AF")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(top = "#B33A3A", random = "#555555", bottom = "#3B75AF")) +
  labs(
    x = "Image regions deleted", y = NULL, color = "Deletion order", fill = "Deletion order",
    title = "Secondary within-model raw-score deletion diagnostics",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Reference seed 41; source-group hierarchical 95% CIs (",
      params$bootstrap_iterations, " resamples). Magnitudes are not compared across architectures."
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9)
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(figure_root, "figure_06_logit_margin_deletion_curves.pdf"),
  curve_plot, width = 10.8, height = 6.1
)
ggsave(
  file.path(figure_root, "figure_06_logit_margin_deletion_curves.png"),
  curve_plot, width = 10.8, height = 6.1, dpi = 320
)
```

## External confusion matrices and class counts

```{r external-supplement}
external_root <- file.path(
  project_root, "artifacts", "crc_val_external", "common_seven", "classification"
)
confusion <- read_csv(
  file.path(external_root, "confusion_matrices_long.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  group_by(model, true_class, predicted_class) |>
  summarise(row_proportion = mean(row_proportion), .groups = "drop")

external_counts <- read_csv(
  file.path(external_root, "external_class_counts.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  group_by(class_name) |>
  summarise(images = sum(images), source_folders = paste(source_class, collapse = "+"),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(match(class_name, c(
    "tumor", "stroma", "lymphocytes", "adipose", "background",
    "normal_mucosa", "debris_mucus"
  )))
write_csv(external_counts, file.path(output_root, "table_external_common_seven_counts.csv"))

class_order <- c(
  "tumor", "stroma", "lymphocytes", "adipose", "background",
  "normal_mucosa", "debris_mucus"
)
class_labels <- c(
  tumor = "Tumor", stroma = "Stroma", lymphocytes = "Lymphocytes",
  adipose = "Adipose", background = "Background",
  normal_mucosa = "Normal mucosa", debris_mucus = "Debris/mucus"
)

confusion <- confusion |>
  mutate(
    model = factor(model, levels = model_order),
    true_class = factor(true_class, levels = rev(class_order), labels = rev(class_labels)),
    predicted_class = factor(predicted_class, levels = class_order, labels = class_labels)
  )

confusion_plot <- ggplot(confusion, aes(predicted_class, true_class, fill = row_proportion)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(row_proportion >= 0.005, percent(row_proportion, accuracy = 1), "")),
    size = 2.15, color = ifelse(confusion$row_proportion > 0.55, "white", "#202020")
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~model, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#F7F7F5", "#C9D9DD", "#4D8B8D", "#173F4A"),
    limits = c(0, 1), labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    x = "Predicted class", y = "True class", fill = "Row %",
    title = "CRC-VAL-HE-7K coarse-label external confusion matrices",
    subtitle = "Row-normalized proportions averaged across seeds 11, 89, and 181"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(figure_root, "figure_s_external_confusion.pdf"),
  confusion_plot, width = 11.2, height = 4.6
)
ggsave(
  file.path(figure_root, "figure_s_external_confusion.png"),
  confusion_plot, width = 11.2, height = 4.6, dpi = 320
)
```
